entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, what did you want to talk about?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Well, um... I was wondering if you could[n]maybe lend me some cash.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: It's nothing real major, but I need it like,[n]right now... I'll pay you back though,[n]honest! Pleeease!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Does this have to do with Tsukasa?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Mm-hm...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: He dropped a super expensive bottle[n]of sake at work, so the club's making[n]him pay for it... but he needs help.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...He's lying to you, Eiko.[n]Don't give him any money.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: He's not lying!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I know you're all weird about[n]the fact that he's a host, but[n]my Tsukasa's not like that!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: He's really gentle, and honest too...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: He even calls me "princess"! I'm the[n]only one he says that to, y'know. He[n]says it's 'cause I'm special.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So he calls you his special princess...[n]What do you think, [fName]-kun?
He says that to all his girls.[clr 27]
That's how he ropes you in.[clr 27]
I'm not sure.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have to agree.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Every girl who gives him money is[n]his "princess." That way he can[n]never get their names mixed up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you ask me, that name is[n]likely how he tricks you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Every girl who gives him money is[n]his "princess." That way he can[n]never get their names mixed up.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Don't accuse him of that stuff![n]You don't have any proof!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...You're not wrong about that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But did you ask anyone at his[n]club about the broken bottle?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: W-Well, um... no...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: He told me not to talk to them[n]about it though! He's too proud[n]to have me go crying to his boss.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: ...Please, Makoto. You're the[n]only person I can trust.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: All my other friends would rather[n]focus on cram school and entrance[n]exams than take time to help me...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: And who knows what my parents'd[n]say if I tried to ask them...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Please. Even a little...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I think you should end your[n]relationship with him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you don't put a stop to this,[n]he might try to drag you into[n]some suspicious line of work...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Oh, he already got me a job.[n]It's nothing weird though.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I'm just serving drinks at a bar to[n]help him pay off that broken bottle.[n]He said I'll be number one in no time.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Maybe I'll just keep doing it after[n]I graduate high school though. I mean,[n]it's not like I'm gonna go to college.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You can't just do what he says![n]He's trying to deceive you...!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: ...A smart person like you totally[n]wouldn't understand what it's like.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: You're just gonna go to a good college,[n]work at a fancy company, and then what?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: At the end of the day, your life's[n]gonna be totally boring. I mean, is[n]that seriously how you wanna live?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... I'm not sure yet.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But be that as it may, you should still[n]stay as far away from him as you can.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: ...So you're not gonna help me?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Ugh, just forget it. I can make[n]it up if I just let some customers[n]take me out on dates after work.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko, wait!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I didn't want to have to tell[n]you this, but Tsukasa has been[n]texting me almost constantly.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Recently he's been asking if my[n]sister and I live alone, and that[n]he'd be glad to help us out.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even today he asked me if I'm still happy[n]with my boyfriend... Listen to me, Eiko:[n]He's not serious about you.

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Don't gimme that crap!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Tsukasa's just so nice that he'd[n]worry about my friends for me...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Wait, you were texting him behind[n]my back? What the hell, Makoto!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was mostly him texting me...

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Ugh! You have the grades, the looks,[n]a cool boyfriend... and you seriously[n]still want more!?

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Tsukasa is all I have...!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: You can't take him from me!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not what I'm trying to do!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: Yeah right. Just keep your hands off!

entries.speaker: Eiko
entries.en: I'd never forgive you if you[n]stole him away, Makoto...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Tsukasa is all she has...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, I think she's exactly the[n]kind of girl those gangs in Shinjuku[n]are on the lookout for.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Lonely, depressed girls who have[n]nowhere to vent their frustrations...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko's family is quite well off.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Her multi-talented younger brother[n]seems to be the sole focus of her[n]parents' attention though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sure that's why she fell for[n]Tsukasa in the first place. He[n]treats her like she's special.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... asking a high schooler for[n]money isn't normal boyfriend behavior.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She needs to realize that.[n]You're going to help, right?
Absolutely.[clr 27]
What are we going to do?
Eh, she deserves him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you. It's reassuring to[n]hear you say that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not entirely sure yet... but I[n]doubt I'll be able to do it alone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please, [fName]-kun. Everyone[n]makes mistakes now and again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Eiko's blessed to have both money[n]and a family... yet she's still trying[n]to break free from them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She's almost the exact opposite of me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...But I guess in a sense, watching her[n]now is almost like looking back at[n]my past self.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was so blinded by my own convictions[n]that I never stopped to consider other[n]alternative viewpoints on the world.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... that's not the right way to live.[n]I want to show her that, just like you[n]did for me.
I can sense a deep bond[n]of trust from Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know she wants me to stay out of[n]her business, but I'd never forgive[n]myself if I let this come to pass.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What is the right way to live...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...At any rate, we're going to catch[n]that horrible host. I'll let you know[n]once I've thought of how to do it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you again for today.[n]I'll see you later.
